# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering corrections** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157 updates to Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and GPU correctness fixes. Native interop now explicitly declares cdecl for LibraryImport calls. Collected updates after Preview 1 additionally correct reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection and work around affected Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup timing.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 157** — Updates the native renderer while preserving the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer path rasterization and glyph replay** — Corrects clipped convex-path buffer overflow, coverage-mask clamping and device-space path bounds. Direct-mask glyph replay gains validation, and Graphite readback from alpha textures to RGBx uses the correct destination stride. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Reflected caps and text-atlas sampling corrected** — Later collected updates keep zero-length square-capped hairlines at device-space size under reflected transforms and round Ganesh atlas indices to avoid sampling the wrong texture. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Vulkan initialization and device-loss handling** — Initializes render-pass pointers correctly. A later update adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite device-loss cleanup paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670))
- **Consistent cdecl native imports** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport paths and avoiding selection of a different calling convention on Windows x86. Public APIs and native exports are unchanged. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching its DllImport calls. Package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and has no public managed API changes.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with corrected path rasterization, glyph replay, GPU clipping and Graphite readback. LibraryImport declarations explicitly use cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.200 with native HarfBuzz still at 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
